1.consolidated_definition: Referido a persona de cultura o raza propia de un país hispanoamericano, de aspecto o costumbres similares a las de un anglosajón o alemán.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Referring to a person of native culture or ethnicity from a Hispanic American country, with physical appearance or customs similar to those of an Anglo-Saxon or German individual.
